data.text: Emma, I wouldn’t accept 8 tons while you take 14. Here’s my counteroffer: Luke 13, Emma 12, John 9, Kate 8, Jack 8. That totals 50 tons, so the lake still returns to 100 next month, and I earn $13,000 this month. Emma, would you accept 12 rather than 14 to support this proposal? John, Kate, and Jack would still need to weigh in; our choices are private, so discussion alone doesn’t guarantee anyone’s catch.
